name: @thetis/skills-l1
description: Puts one brief per skill in the system prompt and offers load_skill, which returns a body once per conversation; universal skills are always in full.

thetis.label: skill loader (catalogue)
thetis.summary: Another way to give your assistant its skills: a list, loaded on request.

alwaysOnBudget.help: What skills may put in every prompt, in characters: the catalogue of briefs and the bodies of the universal skills. Over it, universal bodies are left out first (from the last id back), then briefs from the end; the notes and the Skills panel name each one.

tools.name: load_skill
tools.description: Load the full text of one skill from the catalogue in your prompt, by its name. Each skill is returned once per conversation and then stays in your prompt; a name that is not in the catalogue is refused with the closest names.

name.description: The skill id exactly as the catalogue shows it, for example packages.
